purpose: Qualify visit intent before content generation while keeping visitor choice explicit, bounded and portable across cities.

content_model.base_episode: One clear, complete episode per accepted stop.
content_model.optional_extensions: Use existing episode.extras for deeper or alternate readings when materially useful.
content_model.bridges: Optional extensions may invite another axis, but must never be required to understand the base visit.
content_model.duration: Target episode duration is a design input and QA signal, not a hard runtime truncation rule.

navigation_model.step_navigation: Keep per-step external maps deep links.
navigation_model.overview_navigation: A visit may expose one overview_maps_url for the full accepted route.

human_gate.required_when: Two or more materially different artistic intentions remain legitimate after research and challenge.
human_gate.shape: Present 2-4 concrete discriminating briefs; human selects one or requests adjustment.
